topics.title: Howard and Jackie’s Obsessive Kissing
topics.summary: During an interview segment, Howard repeatedly expresses his attraction to intern Jackie while discussing a possible romantic connection. He attempts multiple kisses, leading to Dr. King’s hypnosis services and a concerned phone call from Jackie's father, escalating into awkward interactions.

topics.summary: A radio host attempts a bizarre hypnosis session with his wife and daughter via the airwaves, escalating into chaotic phone calls involving unsettling suggestions like castration fantasies and multiple women under control. The hosts struggle to maintain order amidst increasingly absurd demands and conversations.

topics.title: Hypnosis Course Discussion
topics.summary: During a radio show, callers discuss taking hypnosis courses with a man and referencing Dr. King's ability to hypnotize people. They suggest using hypnosis on Howard Stern or Jackie Martin, detailing increasingly explicit fantasies involving multiple women and physical interactions, culminating in an attempt to hypnotize the guests.

topics.summary: During a radio interview, Doctor King describes an explicit encounter with two women – Lauren the aerobics instructor and Lenny – involving intense physical activity, multiple orgasms, and detailed accounts of sexual acts.
